### Observed differences

- Activity A01 was not observed in any of the 200 earlier traces; in the later window it appears in about 47 in 100 traces, with about 96 occurrences per 100 traces (roughly two each time it is present) and more than one occurrence in about 23 in 100 traces, sitting around the middle of the trace (mean relative position about 0.39). [OCC001, POS001]
- In the earlier window, A11, A03 and A10 led mainly directly to A04 (about 96, 53 and 47 in 100 of their observed outgoing transitions respectively); in the later window those shares fell to about 22, 10 and 13 in 100, while transitions from A11, A03 and A10 to A01 appeared at about 76, 42 and 25 in 100 respectively. [DIR005, DIR002, DIR004]
- In the later window, A01's outgoing transitions lead mainly to A04 (about 76 in 100), with smaller shares to A13 (about 10) and A11 (about 7). [DIR001]
- Pairs involving A01 changed from never sharing a trace to occurring together: A01 and A04 now co-occur in about 47 in 100 traces, in varying orders (A01 before A04 in about 20, the reverse in about 5, interleaved or repeated in about 23); A01 with A03 in about 27, with A11 in about 23, and with A10 in about 20 — all zero in the earlier window. [REL002, REL001, REL004, REL003]
- Step distances between established pairs shifted about one position later: A10 to A04 was adjacent in about 47 in 100 observed pairs before versus two steps apart in about 51 after; A03 to A04 moved from one step (about 55 in 100) to two steps (about 63); A11 to A04 from one step (about 23) to two steps (about 32); A03 to A11 from three steps (nearly all) to four steps (about 91); A10 to A11 from three steps (about 81) to four steps (about 82); A11 to A11 from three steps (about 33) to four steps (about 47); A04 to A04 from three steps (about 40) to four or five steps (about 39 together). Several of these rest on only about 20–50 observed pairs per window. [LAG005, LAG001, LAG007, LAG002, LAG006, LAG008, LAG003]
- A04 occurs in somewhat fewer traces in the later window (about 47 versus 55 in 100) and slightly later within traces (mean relative position about 0.44 versus 0.39); its outgoing transitions remain dominated by A13 (about 89 in 100, down from about 99) and now include about 10 in 100 to A01. [POS002, DIR003]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that A01, not observed in the earlier window, was introduced into the flow between the A11/A03/A10 stage and A04: previously A11, A03 and A10 led mainly directly to A04, whereas in the later window they lead mainly to A01, A01 leads mainly on to A04, and A04 also feeds back into A01 in about 10 in 100 of its outgoing transitions, with A01 typically occurring about twice in the traces that contain it. [OCC001, DIR001, DIR005, DIR002, DIR004, DIR003]

Supporting signs: 20 items qualified against roughly 0.23 expected by chance among the 46 tested units, so the pattern as a whole is not what an unchanged process typically produces; A01's rise from zero participation is observed directly; the direct A11→A04 transition nearly disappears while A11→A01 and A01→A04 become dominant; A01 newly co-occurs with all four neighbouring activities; and pairwise distances beyond that point grow by about one step, as expected when an extra step sits before A04. [OCC001, DIR005, DIR001, REL002, LAG005, LAG001]

Limitations: the many LAG and REL items describe one underlying rerouting rather than independent confirmations; DIR shares are over outgoing transitions rather than cases; and A01's earlier absence means only that it was not observed then. An important competing explanation the evidence cannot fully rule out is that A01 is a newly added parallel or rework branch rather than a strict inline step between A11 and A04 — the collapse of the direct A11→A04 transition and the uniform one-step distance shifts favour insertion, but the A01–A11 pair occurs mostly in interleaved or repeated patterns rather than one fixed order. [REL004, DIR005, LAG007]

Other differences: A04 appears in fewer traces in the later window (about 47 versus 55 in 100); its slightly later position within traces is consistent with the extra step preceding it, but the lower participation itself is not part of the main hypothesis. [POS002]
